description: Logs what Transport Fever 3's native build tools tell game scripts (builder.proposalCreate, builder.proposalPrepareForApply, builder.proposalApply, and the simulation's apply_command events), with the proposal's shape, and refuses the street builder's builds at proposalPrepareForApply, to find out whether a game script can stop a build and take it instead (docs/HOOKS.md). Writes to the TPF3-MP hook's log in a game its launcher started, else the game log. A test tool: it stops every street build while it is active.
name: TPF3-MP probe: build events
summary: Recon for TPF3-MP: logs the build tools' events and refuses street builds. A test tool.
